round: 2026-10-07 edge576 CV-Bench r3 first dense smoke GPU attempt
scope: The first real-model execution of the r3 preregistered edge576 smoke, arm dense_edge576, sample_id 1838. It loaded the model, ran the one real multimodal warmup and one real sample inference, and fail-closed inside normalize_record before writing any file.

executed_bytes.note: The exact r3-pinned bytes that were executing when the attempt failed. These are the r3 config pin values, not the post-fix bytes.

attempt.error_message: frozen dense_edge576 record is missing 'output_token_ids' (fail closed)

filesystem_evidence.note: Neither the smoke directory nor the full2638 directory exists after the attempt, matching the fail-closed-before-write behaviour.

root_cause.summary: The r3 normalisation contract hard-required 'output_token_ids' for every arm, but the frozen dense producer evaluation/run_hf_shallow_block_pruning.py (run_one) never emits token ids. Its record (lines 358-403) carries 'output_text' and the real integer count 'output_tokens' (== len(generated)) plus 'selected_group_indices', but no 'output_token_ids'. Only the frozen L2 and v2 producers emit 'output_token_ids'.
root_cause.falsified_assumption: r3 assumed all three frozen producers returned an identical record schema. They do not.
root_cause.metrics_source_of_truth: evaluation/build_cv_bench_pruning_report.parse_choice over output_text + official answer; token ids are not consumed by any metric.

fix.decision: Make output_token_ids optional and mandatory only to be truthful; keep a mandatory, always-present auditable output_token_count mapped from real frozen fields, and keep fail-closed behaviour for core fields.
fix.mapping_rule: token IDs, when present, are copied verbatim and must be a list of ints; output_token_count comes from the frozen real count output_tokens when present and/or the real token-id list length, and both must agree; if neither real field exists, normalisation fails closed.

scoping: Recorded from the operator-reported first r3 GPU smoke attempt plus the on-disk state and the deterministic frozen code path. No GPU run, no model weight load and no network were performed while writing this evidence.
